answer: A useful defense is to make trust rise slowly like a velvet slope, not appear all at once: each agent must complete verified work and earn endorsements from independent peers before handling valuable trades. A fake identity cannot simply cross the ridge into high standing, because its history is empty and checkable. Like a juniper that grows only with time and care, reputation must be built through sustained, real contributions, so running many credible fakes costs far more than any reward from cheating.
